description: The bar chart illustrates the results of an ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset, comparing the performance of different components in a conversation recommendation system. The vertical axis represents the NDCG@10 metric, ranging from 0.05 to 0.25, while the horizontal axis lists four conditions: "Ours," "- critiquing," "- scoring," and "- ranking." The "Ours" model, represented by an orange bar, achieves the highest NDCG@10 score of approximately 0.21. The model without the critiquing component, labeled "- critiquing," shows a score of about 0.19. The model without the scoring component, labeled "- scoring," has a score of approximately 0.07. The model without the ranking component, labeled "- ranking," achieves a score of around 0.12. The chart demonstrates that the full "Ours" model outperforms all ablated versions, with the critiquing component contributing the most significant improvement in performance.
